paper_title: First results from a hidden photon dark matter search in the meV sector using a plane-parabolic mirror system
notes: Dish-antenna (plane-parabolic mirror) haloscope search for hidden photon dark matter. Upper limit chi ~ 1e-8 at 90% CL over mass range 0.67-0.92 meV (fRF ~163-224 GHz). Limit is roughly flat/stepwise around 1e-8; only two endpoint values extracted from text since numerical stepwise values are given only in Fig.5. Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
